name: SpringBoardAction
tagline: 自定义锁屏左右快捷动作，支持扇形与无背景圆弧菜单。
description: 为锁屏左右按钮配置常用应用、快捷指令和系统动作，并按自己的习惯排列。
单个动作直接执行，多个动作按所选样式展开；应用和快捷指令需要时使用系统认证。
features: 左右独立选择应用、系统动作和快捷指令，支持排序
竖排、Mac 堆栈扇形、无背景圆弧三种展开样式
动作较多时连续拖动查看，无需逐页翻动
独立隐藏左右按钮，保留动作配置
左右独立水平与垂直偏移，统一图标比例
手电筒、相机、勿扰和静音动作
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 首次安装后重启桌面，打开“设置 → 锁屏快捷动作”。
分别选择左右动作，拖动已选条目排序；多个动作会显示省略号入口。
在外观中选择展开样式；动作较多时拖动菜单查看。
按需配置独立隐藏与位置偏移；避免同时启用其他锁屏按钮插件。

changes: 自定义左右锁屏快捷动作，支持应用、快捷指令及单侧隐藏。
提供竖排、Mac 堆栈扇形和无背景圆弧，支持连续拖动查看更多动作。
统一图标比例，改善菜单边缘显示和省略号颜色；设置保留首次安装提示。

en.name: SpringBoardAction
en.tagline: Customize lock screen quick actions with fan and background-free arc menus.
description: Configure the left and right lock screen buttons with your favorite apps, shortcuts, and system actions.
A single action runs directly; multiple actions expand in the selected layout. Apps and shortcuts use system authentication when required.
features: Independent left and right apps, system actions, shortcuts, and ordering
Vertical, Mac stack fan, and background-free arc layouts
Continuous dragging for large action collections, without paging
Hide either button while preserving its configuration
Independent horizontal and vertical offsets with consistent icon sizing
Flashlight, camera, Do Not Disturb, and silent actions
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Respring after the first installation, then open Settings → SpringBoardAction.
Select actions for each side and drag selected rows to reorder. Multiple actions use an ellipsis entry.
Choose an expansion style under Appearance and drag overflowing menus to see more actions.
Configure hiding and position offsets as needed. Avoid enabling other lock screen button tweaks at the same time.

changes: Customize left and right lock screen actions with apps, shortcuts, and independent button hiding.
Choose vertical, Mac stack fan, or background-free arc layouts, with continuous dragging to reveal more actions.
Consistent icon sizing, improved menu edge visibility and ellipsis color, and retained first-installation guidance in Settings.
